default.en: Hello there! Welcome to CRABS! Let's take a quick walk through all the interface tools, chat tricks, and navigation features.

back.en: Right back to the start! Happy to run through the whole introduction again whenever you like.

resume.en: Welcome back! Ready to jump back in and tour through the rest of the mod?

default.en: Whenever you join a room, a tidy info banner shows up with all the key details. It'll even redraft automatically when you hop over to a map!

back.en: Like I mentioned: the banner just keeps room details handy whenever you enter or swap views.

resume.en: Welcome back! We were looking at room banners—they automatically show key room info whenever you join or swap views.

default.en: Ever find stylized, decorative chat fonts impossible to read? Just hover your mouse over the text or name, and it'll decode into clean lettering on the spot!

back.en: No need to strain your eyes over fancy script—a quick mouse hover decodes it straight away.

resume.en: Welcome back! As I was saying about fancy chat text: just hover over any illegible font to decode it into standard lettering.

default.en: Whenever someone mentions you in chat, it highlights to match your character's label color! You can also enable desktop notifications for when you're tabbed out.

back.en: Mention highlights simply tint messages to your label color and can ping your desktop if you're elsewhere.

resume.en: Back with me? Excellent! We were just covering chat highlights and background desktop notifications.

default.en: Whisper+ bypasses distance limits on maps! Plus, if a friend steps out before you hit send, it can elevate your message into an account beep automatically.

back.en: Whisper+ reaches anywhere across a map, and turns into an account beep if a friend leaves mid-chat.

resume.en: Welcome back! We were just discussing Whisper+—it works anywhere on maps and can auto-beep friends who step out.

default.en: To slide out the main Roster Drawer, just click the tab on the edge of the screen, press CTRL + ALT + D, or type /crabs into chat.

back.en: You can bring the drawer out anytime with the edge tab, the hotkey, or the /crabs command.

resume.en: Here we are! We were about to open the Roster Drawer using the edge tab, CTRL + ALT + D, or the /crabs command.

default.en: Right along the top bar, you can see live counts for room admins, current occupants, online friends, and total players logged into the game.

back.en: The drawer header gives you a live look at room admins, guest limits, friends, and total online counts.

resume.en: Welcome back! Up in the drawer header, you've got live counts of room admins, players, friends, and total online users.

default.en: Roster cards show relationship tags alongside gag, blindfold, and deaf icons. Click an ID to copy it, click a badge to focus them, or click their name to start a Whisper+!

back.en: Cards show all active status icons and bonds: click the ID to copy, the badge to focus, or the name to whisper.

resume.en: Picking up on roster cards: click an ID to copy it, click the badge to focus their avatar, or click their name to whisper!

default.en: You can cycle the layout between Grid, Stack, or Compact views, and use the dropdown to sort everyone by roles, relationships, or natural room order!

back.en: Feel free to cycle card layouts and sort by roles, relationships, or room order whenever you like.

resume.en: Welcome back! We were just customizing the drawer using the layout cycle button and the sorting dropdown.

default.en: Click the green clock icon to view the last 50 people who left. You can open their WCE profiles, copy their IDs, or send a quick beep to friends!

back.en: The History screen keeps track of the last 50 departed players so you can easily copy IDs or beep friends.

resume.en: Back again! The green clock icon opens Departure History, where you can inspect, beep, or copy IDs for the last 50 visitors.

default.en: While exploring a map, hovering over any card or chat name points a 3D compass straight toward them! You can also click the compass icon on a card to lock tracking in place.

back.en: The compass arrow tracks players across the map in real time, provided room rules allow it!

resume.en: Welcome back! We were covering the compass: hovering a player points right toward them on the map, and clicking it locks tracking.

default.en: It works in reverse, too! Hover over any character avatar in the room or map, and the drawer will automatically scroll and highlight their card for you.

back.en: Hovering over someone in the scene automatically finds and highlights their card in the drawer.

resume.en: Picking back up with Reverse Compass: hovering an avatar in the room automatically scrolls to their roster card.

default.en: In map rooms, clicking your collected keys in the header opens a handy panel to drop your Bronze, Silver, Gold, or All keys without typing a thing!

back.en: The Keys panel lets you drop specific held keys or clear them all at once with a quick click.

resume.en: Welcome back! In map rooms, clicking the header keys opens the quick discard panel to drop keys with one click.

default.en: Click the gear icon to open Settings! Every single toggle takes effect immediately as you click it—no need to look for a save button.

back.en: No saving required here! Any changes you make will update the second you click them.

resume.en: Here in Settings, every toggle and text field saves immediately the moment you adjust it.

default.en: The General tab handles language choices, performance tweaks, room banners, and shortcuts to set up your drawer and privacy hotkeys.

back.en: General takes care of everyday basics: banners, focus halos, performance safeguards, and keybinds.

resume.en: We were looking at the General tab—this is where you adjust banners, performance mode, and hotkey shortcuts.

default.en: Here you can cap the drawer at a tidy 77% height so your chat input stays clear, toggle logo animations, or have it close automatically when you chat.

back.en: The Drawer tab lets you pick compact heights, logo animations, and auto-stow behaviors.

resume.en: Back in Settings! The Drawer tab lets you set compact height, toggle animations, and pick auto-close rules.

default.en: Want full realism? Blur your roster when blindfolded, block Whisper+ when gagged, or use Hardcore Lock so settings can't be touched while bound!

back.en: Immersion keeps things authentic, locking sensory limits in place whenever you're tied up.

resume.en: Welcome back! The Immersion tab enforces sensory blurs and gags, and lets you lock settings while bound.

default.en: Use SuperZoom to unlock map view limits, pick your favorite mention colors, filter out common phrases, and set up whisper-to-beep upgrades.

back.en: These tabs let you broaden your map view, pick highlight shades, and tune your chat alerts.

resume.en: In Maps & Chat, you can enable SuperZoom, customize mention colors, and set up phrase exclusions.

default.en: Keep an eye on your 8KB server limit, switch to local-only mode if you prefer, or easily copy and paste your settings string to share between browsers.

back.en: The Config tab manages cloud syncing, local storage, and lets you export clean backup strings.

resume.en: Almost done! The Config tab lets you check cloud storage limits, switch to local-only mode, or export backup strings.

default.en: Prefer sticking to the keyboard? Quick commands like /crabs, /crabs keys, /w+, and /dropkeys let you run everything straight from the chat bar!

back.en: Handy slash commands let you open rosters, drop keys, and send long-distance whispers directly from chat.

resume.en: We were chatting about keyboard shortcuts: slash commands like /crabs, /w+, and /dropkeys drive features without the mouse.

default.en: If you ever need a quick refresher on icons, badges, or commands, click the blue question mark in the drawer header. Have fun with CRABS!

back.en: The Help button is always up in the drawer corner whenever you need a quick reminder.

resume.en: And that wraps up our tour! The blue question mark in the drawer is always there if you need help later. Click Finish to begin!
